conventions.frame_index: 0-based z in this file; the output STAR uses 1-based rlnMicrographFrameNumber, z = frame - rlnMicrographStartFrame
conventions.axes: x = column = fast axis, y = row = slow axis, origin at pixel (0,0)
conventions.units: pixels of the unbinned grid; angstrom = pixel * pixel_size_angstrom
conventions.injected_motion: displacement of specimen content in frame f relative to frame 0

noise.model: i.i.d. Gaussian in detector coordinates, not warped

periodicity.why: a Fourier shift is cyclic; non-wrapping content puts a mismatched band of width |shift| along two edges and biases any full-frame cross-correlation toward zero shift (measured at 1.2 % on a non-periodic build of this fixture)

grid.layout: endpoint-inclusive: linspace(0, n-1, GRID_N) on each axis
